messages:
emma: Opening a PR to consolidate and prune duplicate provisioning examples in the Dedicated Capacity docs. Focus areas: autoscale policy examples, tenant isolation patterns, SDK/Terraform snippets, and a few link fixes. PTAL when you have a moment.
rohit: Link?
emma: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 - mostly text edits + moving some legacy snippets to an appendix.
sophie: I can take autoscale policy examples. Do we still want separate "burst" vs "steady" columns in the matrix?
emma: Keep both but simplify labels — 'burst' -> 'temporary scale' and 'steady' -> 'sustained throughput'. Cut one column (regional notes) into a footnote.
linda: Noted a couple broken links in isolation-decorators section, left comments in the PR.
chris: Heads up: I updated the Python SDK snippet; old init is deprecated. Replaced `client.init()` with `Client.create()` in the example.
chris: snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client.create(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY", region="us-west-2")
resp = client.provision.dedicated(tenant_id="acme", pool="reserved", min_instances=2)
print(resp.status)
```
sam_engineer: Small migration-guide nit: we should call out difference between "preemption" and "eviction" for reserved pools. People confuse them. Suggest adding a short FAQ entry.
emma: good call. Add a 2-3 line FAQ and an example command for provisioning via CLI.
sam_engineer: example: ```bash
redwoodctl provision --tenant my-tenant --pool reserved --min 2 --max 20 --policy autoscale
```
rohit: I'll add the CLI example under migration guide and wire the SLA tier link (internal) into the table.
rohit: SLA note: standard vs enterprise has different latency/uptime guarantees — I'll add a callout and link to internal SLA matrix: https://internal.redwood/sla/matrix
sophie: Can we also include a short trace or annotation example for isolating noisy tenants? A clear label + resource annotation tends to help oncall.
emma: yes, add an "isolation patterns" subsection with a tiny YAML snippet and rationale. Keep it under 6 lines.
linda: I pushed a tiny fix: updated broken anchor and fixed two markdown link paths. Also flagged one sentence for tone (too salesy for docs).
chris: CI results incoming...
docs-bot: docs-ci / build — PR #4823 — success :white_check_mark: (link: https://ci.internal/4823)
chris: :thumbsup: I'll merge after we clean the remaining TODOs in the PR (one FAQ bullet + the YAML example).
emma: leaving one follow-up task to create a short examples index page (epic). Not blocking this merge.
rohit: added the CLI example and the SLA callout. Also updated the terraform snippet to use the new provider block.
rohit: terraform snippet: ```hcl
provider "redwood" {
  region = "us-west-2"
  api_key = var.redwood_api_key
}
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "acme" {
  tenant = "acme"
  min_instances = 2
  max_instances = 20
}
```
sophie: Looks good. One editorial nit in the autoscale table (units) — I'll fix in a follow-up commit.
emma: thanks everyone — aiming to merge EOD once the tiny edits land. If anyone wants to pick up the examples index epic, comment in the PR. :rocket:
